## The heuristic

**Risk read during a live incident should be recorded and re-read afterwards, never acted on during.**


_Why:_ Everyone is angry at the same time, so tone loses all discriminating power. The informative question is who is still cold once the incident is closed and the goodwill cycle has run its course.
